people.name: Azariah
people.line: Grandfather of Ezra, descended from High Priests

people.name: Hilkiah
people.line: The high priest who discovered the Book of the Law.

people.name: Shallum
people.line: High priest, son of Zadok and father of Hilkiah

translations.web: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.
translations.bsb: Shallum was the father of Hilkiah, Hilkiah was the father of Azariah,
translations.kjv: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
translations.asv: and Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
